findings.title: wbf-04 cannot be built inside its deliverables; ADR does not assign the viewer's openFiles implementation
findings.evidence: ADR-029 lines 247-285 and 356-363 versus backlog phase-wbf-04 deliverables (ts/src/stage/panelBridge.ts only) and HtmlViewerRegion.tsx:289-295 (the handle literal that must implement openFiles); ADR widens wbf-05's deliverables but not wbf-04's
findings.consequence: A required openFiles member breaks wbf-04's npm run build; an optional or implemented one edits a file outside its deliverables; leaving it to wbf-05 leaves R07 without a real target or test file. The wbf-04 builder must guess.
findings.minimal_fix: State which phase implements viewer openFiles and the R07/R08 tests, and note that wbf-04's deliverables need widening to HtmlViewerRegion.tsx and a test file (or make the member optional in wbf-04 and implement in wbf-05).

findings.title: Keyed multi-handle BridgeSlot semantics under-specified (unregister key, get() fallback, stable getAll snapshot)
findings.evidence: ADR lines 249-254; callers HtmlViewerRegion.tsx:296-297 and TerminalRegion.tsx:466-467 pass no key; panelBridge.ts:100,107 use useSyncExternalStore
findings.consequence: A fresh array per getAll() call loops the hook; unregister-by-key and get() fallback order are left to the builder.
findings.minimal_fix: Specify unregister by handle identity across keys, a cached getAll() array replaced only on register/unregister, and get() falling back to the previous remaining handle.

findings.title: 'slot' used for the bridge channel after adopting slot = container vocabulary
findings.evidence: ADR lines 132-134 versus lines 249, 262, 266, 288 ('A slot can hold several live handles', '{ slot, call, key? }')
findings.consequence: Readers will confuse bridge slots with layout slots; the glossary has no BridgeSlot entry.
findings.minimal_fix: Say 'bridge channel (BridgeSlot)' and rename the indicative target field.

findings.title: category_id derivation has unhandled cases (empty slug, Windows reserved device names)
findings.evidence: ADR lines 171-173 (slug pattern, id is file name stem) and 193-195 (Windows supported)
findings.consequence: Names with no ASCII alphanumerics yield an invalid empty id; 'con'/'nul' ids produce files Windows cannot create.
findings.minimal_fix: Add a fallback id with numeric suffix for empty slugs and a suffix rule for reserved device names.

findings.title: Cross-OS validity claim contradicts case-preserving path storage
findings.consequence: Mis-cased entries resolve on Windows but read missing on Linux, contrary to 'leaves every entry valid'.
findings.minimal_fix: Narrow the claim to absolute-path breakage and state case mismatches surface as missing.

findings.title: ADR-009 and ADR-015 extended in effect with no signpost; data root outside repo unaddressed
findings.evidence: src/db/source_validation.py:44-50 (only ENTITY_DIRECTORIES honour the override) versus ADR line 366; ADR-015 rule 4 'Read-only' text unchanged; data_root() may be absolute outside the repo
findings.consequence: A later reader of ADR-015 or ADR-009 meets an unflagged contradiction; write boundary for an out-of-repo data root is not stated.
findings.minimal_fix: Add an open item: on ratification add an 'extended by ADR-029' pointer to ADR-015 rule 4, update the data_root() docstring, and state the data root is itself the write boundary.
